newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines GMA Network plans radio expansion.
newsitem.headline: Philippines GMA Network plans radio expansion.

text.p: Philippines' GMA Network Inc said on Friday it had earmarked 400 million pesos to expand its radio broadcast operation.
The expansion programme includes the setting up of 12 additional stations in central and southern Philippines and purchase of properties for its local radio and television operations.
At present, there are 14 GMA radio stations operating in the country.

"This is the most ambitious, most aggressive and most exciting expansion programme in the industry today," Mike Enriquez, president of Radio Global Media Arts, a subsidiary of GMA Network, said in a statement.
GMA is the arch-rival of ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp, the country's leading television and radio company.
GMA has earlier said it is planning to launch an initial public offering of shares in the next few months.
